A specialized gambling-compliance investigative outlet (FinTelegram, July 2024) subsequently reported that zetcasino.com is operated by Liernin Enterprises Ltd using only a Philippines/PAGCOR offshore license that does not entitle the site to operate in Europe or other jurisdictions where it is nonetheless accepting players — and flagged it as a compliance risk.
